mapper.select: SELECT tu.tenant_id FROM tenant_user tu INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id = tu.tenant_id WHERE tu.user_id = #{userId} AND tu.status = 1 AND tu.valid = 1 AND t.tenant_type = 1 AND t.status = 1 AND t.valid = 1 ORDER BY tu.id LIMIT 1

SELECT t.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.tenant_type AS tenantType FROM tenant_user tu INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id = tu.tenant_id WHERE tu.user_id = #{userId} AND tu.status = 1 AND tu.valid = 1 AND t.tenant_type = 1 AND t.status = 1 AND t.valid = 1 ORDER BY tu.id LIMIT 1
